snippet.title: Pit Panic – Official Gameplay Trailer | The Game Is Out Now!
snippet.description:
Pit Panic is OUT NOW! 🐀⛏️

Escape a collapsing Aztec temple in this fast-paced rogue-like 2D platformer!

Dig your own path, grapple through deadly chambers, dodge traps, defeat ancient bosses, and race other players in daily challenges. Every run combines more than 1,000 handcrafted levels into a new journey towards the surface.

There are many ways to die, but only one way to survive: UP!

PLAY PIT PANIC NOW:

🔥 Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2491490/Pit_Panic/

⚡ Epic Games Store
https://store.epicgames.com/p/pit-panic-4c89ff

💜 GOG
